description:
🚀 We are OrbitHub, a team of young explorers passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation! We believe curiosity, creativity, and teamwork can turn big ideas into real solutions. Supported by a mentor experienced in AI, Data Engineering, and software development, we explore challenges, develop projects, and learn by doing. At OrbitHub, kids lead the journey, transforming imagination into discovery!

🌎 Small Explorers, Big Discoveries!
